title: ICAI Extends Time Limit for Goodwill Transfer of Deceased Member's Proprietary Firm
content:
# ICAI Extends Time Limit for Goodwill Transfer of Deceased Member's Proprietary Firm

Hello everyone! Ek important update hai ICAI ki taraf se. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne deceased member ke proprietary firm ke goodwill transfer ke liye time limit extend karne ka announce kiya hai. This is a welcome move for members and their families.

Here are the key details:
*   **Announcement Date:** July 25, 2026.
*   **Old Due Date/Time Limit:** The earlier provision allowed one year from the date of the member's death for the transfer of goodwill.
*   **New Due Date/Time Limit:** The Council of ICAI has now approved an increase in this time limit from one year to **three years** from the date of the member's death.
*   **Impacted Document:** This change will be reflected in the provisions relating to goodwill appearing in the Code of Ethics, 2026, Volume I.

This extension provides more flexibility and time to complete the necessary formalities for goodwill transfer, easing the process during a difficult time for the deceased member's family.
